sql: select count(*) as "count" from "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "crm_accounts"."id" = "leads"."account_id" and "archived_at" is null) and (("management_type" = $1 or "management_type" = $2) and ("management_type" is null or "management_type" != $3))

select * from "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "crm_accounts"."id" = "leads"."account_id" and "archived_at" is null) and (("management_type" = $1 or "management_type" = $2) and ("management_type" is null or "management_type" != $3)) order by "fecha_creacion" desc, "id" desc limit $4 offset $5
